note: Alberta Parks recreation area run by West Fraser Mills and the Fox Creek Development Association, 63 km southeast of Robb on Hwy 40, by the Pembina River; large, well-spaced sites among spruce, with free firewood. In wet spring weather Highway 47 can be rough, and a 4-wheel-drive or high-clearance vehicle is then recommended. Fishing on this stretch of the Pembina is closed all year. --Claude
